---
title: "Newsletter"
description: "One email a month with the latest issues."
body-classes: pv-centred
---

Once a month, readers on the list get one email: a short summary of the new Monitor issue and a link to it on this site. When a Commentary issue comes out, the same email announces it too. Nothing else is sent.

::: {.pv-centre}
[Subscribe](https://stats.sender.net/forms/erkOWk/view){.pv-button .pv-button-big}
:::

You confirm with one click in an email, and every newsletter has a link to unsubscribe. The list is kept with Sender, an email service in the EU, and your address is used only for this newsletter. See the [privacy page](../legal/privacy.qmd).
